ticket.subject: Payment failed for Scale renewal
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Writing on behalf of Saltmarsh Robotics. The card payment for our Scale renewal was declined, and we got a warning that access will be suspended.

Our bank says it never saw the payment attempt, so we think the problem is on the payment side. We already updated the card details once and the retry failed again. This has already cost us a morning of work.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Please stop the suspension while we sort out the payment.

Thanks,
Kenji

label_notes: clean billing (billing-card-declined): a failed renewal with suspension pending blocks the whole account with no workaround, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
